text_block_list.text:
The day of the Osaka Hai arrived.
Eishin Flash was remarkably calm.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ――Now then, shall we look back at the noteworthy runners?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
First is Fuji Kiseki.
It might not be her best distance,
but she'll definitely be in the mix for the win.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
And Manhattan Cafe.
She says she feels a sense of destiny regarding the upcoming Spring Shield, and is fired up to not lose today's race either...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
She is our most dangerous rival today.
She seems to have great compatibility with this track, and she's delivered solid results leading up to this.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"It seems today's race
is bound to be a fierce one as well."
choice_data_list: Still, it looks kind of fun, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...!
Does it look that way to you?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes. I can feel my heart pounding.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: It's strange. Just two months ago, I was completely terrified.
choice_data_list: Looks like you have some room to breathe now.
Looks like you have some room to breathe now.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Up until now,
I have diligently built up proper training.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Then with my head held high,
I will keep running... down the path I believe in!
